Request Activation adds one canonical runtime-contract file, a fingerprint-bound passive guard projected into the router and all ten skills, definition-owned module inventory, silent ordinary-request abstention, and passive binding identity without another hook, classifier, prompt transport, or dispatcher field. The reviewed atomic canonical-init, strict lifecycle-envelope, stale-package cleanup, host-evidence schema, and control-setup continuation changes raise the measured payload to 85 files/696486 bytes.
